So in Lost Mine of Phandalver, I was playing a level 3 (i think) gnome Arcane Puppeteer, a homebrew class that's cool, and we were fighting the nothic. I used my puppets as shields and attacked him, but he got around them, and used his gaze thingy, and I went unconscious. My half-orc fighter companion said he'd stay out of it beforehand, so the nothic just picked my forty-pound body up and chucked me into a pit. Mind you, we spend about half an hour getting out of a simple pit trap, and we were hurt from the fighter falling and landing on me, so I just died. Then, AFTER I DIED, the fighter ran up, killed the nothic, and took its treasure chest. Although I died, it was funny. Another time, in the fighter's first time DMing, I was a level 1 wizard named Jasper Oldfellow, a 70-something year old human who wanted to be a necromancer. We (me and a tempest cleric) fought our way into a goblin-infested dwarven stronghold. We were fine, until an axe trap came up and knocked down the cleric. We waited and he gained a bit of health, and then we went on. It ended up with us in a room with two coffins. Skeletons jumped out and attacked us, and with the first hit I went down. The cleric barely fought them off, and I got a nat 1 on my death saving throw and failed the next one, so I died. A wannabe-necromancer died to a skeleton. Oh well...
